capabilities: Search a Linkwarden library and insert links bound to entry ids
Show linked sources' highlights in a right-sidebar panel
Insert highlights as callout quotes with block ids
Archive a note's external URLs to Linkwarden and rewrite them to deep links
Re-bind links whose Linkwarden id changed
disambiguation: Not a bookmark sync tool; nothing is materialized as files in the vault — highlights are read from the service into a panel.
extras: The README states the plugin is not officially from the Linkwarden project, requires Obsidian >= 1.12.7, and on Linux needs an OS secret backend (kwallet/libsecret); the token is stored device-local via SecretStorage and never enters the synced vault.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to search Linkwarden bookmarks, view their highlights next to the active note, or archive note URLs to the service.

relations.evidence: This plugin communicates with exactly one remote service: your Linkwarden instance

summary: Client for the Linkwarden bookmark service that binds notes to saved links, shows their highlights in a side panel, and archives URLs.
